body.summary: When the activation probe finds an installed daemon stopped, the extension re-checks reachability and then starts it once as a plain start (the controller's run gains a plain option adding --skip-sync --skip-install --skip-build, so nothing is pulled, installed or built); a failed start, or a success that leaves the daemon unreachable, shows as errored with the reason. ActivationDeps gains an optional controller and an onSettled callback; the settings pull from the daemon, the update check and the first-run onboarding now wait for activation to settle, so they find the daemon the start brought up. The live checks were run by the user after installing the rebuilt vsix.
